notes.title: GLOBAL UPDATE - ONLY UP! UP! UP!
notes.content:
Announcement of the "HUMBLE ZOMBIE ONLY UP! UP! UP!" Game Update for Steam

Dear players!

We are excited to present to you the highly anticipated major update for the game "HUMBLE ZOMBIE ONLY UP! UP! UP!". We have made numerous enhancements and additions to make your gaming experience even more thrilling and engaging. Here are the key features that await you:

1. Nine new single-player locations: Dense jungles, barren landscapes, icy caves, and many other unique places. Each location has its own characteristics and puzzles that you must solve to progress.

2. Stunning new large stylized location "ASIA": Prepare for an immersive adventure in a grand and vibrant location filled with dangers and secrets. 

3. Gigantic "Only Up! Up! Up!" map: Embark on an incredible ascent on a massive map, climbing to great heights. Show your endurance and skill as you overcome challenges and evade obstacles to reach the summit.

4. New gameplay element: "Puch": We have added the ability to give slaps to other players on the server. Now you can playfully tease your friends and urge them to complete the locations faster. It's a great opportunity for teamwork and creating amusing moments.

5. "Endless" mode with endlessly generated locations: Our development team has created a new mode where you can enjoy endless gameplay. Each time you start the game, the location will be randomly generated, offering you new challenges and adventures.

6. Updated main menu: We have completely revamped the main menu of the game to make it more stylish and user-friendly. Now you can quickly and easily find all the necessary functions and settings.

7. Fixed "Fatal Error" bug in multiplayer: We have addressed the issue that caused game crashes in multiplayer mode. Now you can enjoy seamless and smooth gameplay, interacting with other players without any issues.

We have put in maximum effort to make this update unforgettable for you. We hope you appreciate all the new features and functionalities we have added. Wishing you good luck in your zombie climbing, exploring new locations, and having a blast with your friends!

Sincerely,
The development team of "HUMBLE ZOMBIE ONLY UP! UP! UP!" game
